title: Enterprise Connectivity: invoice corrections
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs invoice corrections for credit, upward adjustment.

## Policy clause 1
For source classification correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

## Policy clause 2
This gate is inapplicable to other source classification values.

## Policy clause 3
Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net service subtotal plus tax component, following tax treatment rules.

## Policy clause 4
Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

## Superseded scope 5
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for assisted correction posting. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

## Policy clause 6
A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

## Policy clause 7
An upward correction carries positive amount.

## Policy clause 8
Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

## Policy clause 9
No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

## Policy clause 10
Link source-event reference to the original charge and related-review reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

## Policy clause 11
Use gross correction component from separately tracked correction and outage credits for the correction comparison; pretax outage credit component never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Evidence condition 1
For credit, upward adjustment, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: For source classification correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source classification values. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, related-review reference, status, decision. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, related-review reference to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Correction accumulation
All posted credit and upward adjustment events through the fixed current handling time for the exact source-event reference. For the exact original charge, the gross correction component is the absolute correction credit amount less upward-adjustment amount. Tax is included in this correction component; unrelated charges are excluded.

## Points of judgement
Use gross correction component from separately tracked correction and outage credits for the correction comparison; pretax outage credit component never changes the approved corrected billing target.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the monetary decimal places, rounding convention used by this rule.

## Record identity: credit
A source-line correction or outage credit decreases the contract receivable. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch.

## Record identity: upward adjustment
An approved upward source-line correction increases the contract receivable. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, meter type, source classification, selected pricing branch.
